sources.title: Hoholdt, van Lint and Pellikaan, Algebraic geometry codes
sources.publication: Handbook of Coding Theory, volume 1, 1998, pages 871-961
sources.read: Identified title/authors; Theorem 2.55 and Corollary 2.58, Example 2.74; Definitions 6.2-6.3, Lemma 6.4 and full proof, Proposition 6.5 and full proof; Example 3.19 for the alternative monomial convention.
sources.scope: Standard geometric and decoding inputs; our separate self-contained proof uses evaluation codes, a protected normalization, explicit monomial bases and construction costs.

sources.title: Pellikaan, On the existence of error-correcting pairs
sources.publication: Journal of Statistical Planning and Inference 51 (1996), 229-242
sources.read: Definition 2.1, Remark 2.2, Section 4 including Propositions 4.1-4.2 and Remark 4.3 and following construction caveat.
sources.scope: Established decoding attribution and comparison; extension-field existence alone does not provide the explicit pair-construction cost. Its numerical extension bound is not used.

sources.title: Stacks Project, Riemann-Roch and plane curves
sources.scope: Navigation to standard curve statements; the exact Riemann-Roch statement and Hermitian genus formula used in this cycle were read in the locally retrieved author survey and the full recorded locator proof.

redistribution: Full third-party text retained privately; not included in public research artifacts.
checks: Symbolic proofs and exact substitutions; no new numerical experiment or decoder implementation.
